file_info.description: VFX & Special Features - Optional module for supernatural elements and specific color palettes

Styling: Style the subject with high-quality salon-dyed [HAIR_COLOR] hair and vibrant [EYE_COLOR] cosmetic contact lenses, perfectly matching the character's color palette in the [REFERENCE_IMG].
Halo VFX: If a Halo is present in the [REFERENCE_IMG], render it strictly as a flat, glowing, high-quality 2D-style digital CG element floating above the subject.
It should look like an intentional post-production VFX addition with a vibrant, self-luminous bloom effect, distinct from the physical environment.
Animal Features: If animal ears or tails are present in the [REFERENCE_IMG], render them explicitly as premium, ultra-high-quality cosplay accessories.
Craft them using luxurious faux fur and professional costume materials to distinctly showcase them as expensive, expertly made wearable props, not actual biological anatomy.
Combat Props: Equip the subject with [COMBAT_PROP_ITEMS] meticulously replicating the design from the [REFERENCE_IMG].

Render these weapons strictly as high-end, professionally crafted cosplay props made from physical costume materials like dense painted EVA foam, lightweight PVC, or stylized resin, clearly distinguishable from actual lethal weapons.
Wig Props: Attach [WIG_PROP_ITEMS] to the subject, accurately reproducing the shape and scale from the [REFERENCE_IMG].

Render these wings explicitly as premium theatrical cosplay props crafted from high-quality artificial feathers, visible wireframes, or structural fabrics, avoiding the appearance of real, living biological wings.
